abstract: This senior project built a smart home model that automates seven zones of a house, including the living room, kitchen, bedroom, toilet, garden, entrance, and hallway. NodeMCU ESP8266 boards connect sensors and relays to the internet and send real time data to Firebase, while an Anto.io dashboard lets users monitor and control the devices. The system detects flame and gas in the kitchen, controls the bedroom fan with a DHT11 temperature sensor, responds to clap commands in the toilet, and waters the garden automatically based on soil moisture. Lights in the living room can be switched by voice through Google Assistant and IFTTT. Testing equipment, development tools, and the completed model are budgeted at a total of 5,000 baht.

The way people travel has changed because of technologies. So, we decided to create this project, which is a travel diary, mobile application for helping users to keep tracks of locations and experiences along their trip just like they’re making their own travel journals. We designed the application to be user generated content, which users can start a trip, then select location to check-in, write reviews and add photos to record that in to their trip. They can keep checking-in until the trip ends, which the ended trip will be keep in the past trips, where users can come back and take a look.

In this report, we proposed a system for people sensor to keep track of people movement with computer vision technology. This report consists of 3 main concepts: (1) people detection, (2) people tracking and (3) people counting. A Deep Neural Network architecture is used for people detections and Kalman Filter is being used for tracking purposes. On top on that we’ve proposed a method to make probabilistic assumption for multi-object tracking across different images.

abstract: The ISL Room Sensor is a sensor box built to detect the state of a room and reduce wasted electricity. It uses a Raspberry Pi with Arduino and Grove Pi together with temperature and humidity, light, sound, thermopile, and motion sensors. The Raspberry Pi streams sensor data into Firebase where a filtering module applies a Kalman filter, then an SVM predicts room occupancy while threshold and rule based models detect the light and air conditioner states. The system also flags anomalies such as lights or air conditioning left on in an empty room and displays results on admin and user screens. Trained on data recorded in a room at Assumption University Hua Mak campus, it reached perfect precision and recall for light detection and near 96 percent accuracy for occupancy detection.

canonical_title: ISL Text Mining And Analytics Platform
abstract: In this report I present a platform that is able to process large amounts of text data and serve it for quantitative real-time analytics based on terms and concepts extracted from the text. The work consists of four main components; text extraction in form of web scrapers, text processing pipeline in form of data-stream processing application, text classification in form of a concept-predictor API and a set of analytical API endpoints in form of cloud-functions.
